                    ### Options

opb. An abdominal ultrasound to confirm the presence of ascites.
opc. An exploratory paracentesis to rule out a spontaneous bacterial peritonitis.
opd. An electroencephalogram to confirm the existence of hepatic encephalopathy.
ope. An abdominal computed tomography to rule out a hepatocellular carcinoma.
